scope: Vertically center Launcher options labels and antialias the checkmark.
environment: Disposable KDE neon Wayland / Plasma 6.8.1 / Qt 6.11.1 / scale 2
coverage_limits: Visual checks ran at 2× scale in a disposable KDE neon Wayland VM.
Visual verification used Wayland. Isolated X11 probes cover launcher behavior without qualifying the compositor's visual output.
The preexisting Acrylic Glass plugin was built and enabled for the VM comparison. The patch changes only Launcher QML and its component hash.

checks.command: QT_QUICK_CONTROLS_STYLE=org.kde.desktop python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_launcher_presets.py -k 'native_launcher_popup_presets and ((MacTahoe and Light and 1) or (MacGoldenGate and Dark and 2))'
Disposable Plasma VM Launcher's options menu with Acrylic Glass on and off
checks.detail: Both editions and both appearance modes. Highlighted label measured centered, check edges antialiased, and the same backdrop softened with Acrylic Glass enabled.

captures.description: Both editions in light and dark with a magnified checkmark and Acrylic Glass comparison.
